name: Pashur
overview: The name Pashur appears in Scripture as belonging to several individuals connected to the priesthood and temple leadership, notably as a son of Malchiah and as a son of Immer who served as chief governor in the house of the LORD. These men were heads of influential families, with their descendants numbering in the thousands, as recorded in Ezra and Nehemiah. One Pashur, son of Immer, is specifically noted for his opposition to the prophet Jeremiah, even imprisoning him, while his son Gedaliah also persecuted Jeremiah, illustrating the challenges faced by God’s messengers within the religious establishment.
